description: Variation of condition 2 of planning application ref: 2024/01842/LBC granted 30th January 2026 for the 'Installation of 2no VRF heat pumps to northern elevation of the building at lower ground floor level; removal of air conditioning units from main roof level; internal alterations to include: repair and redecoration works and removal of former NHS fitout including fitted kitchens, sinks, worktops, lightweight partition, roller racking and bespoke services including 2no air conditioning (AC) split systems; energy improvement works comprising of decommissioning of existing gas boilers and low temperature hot water (LTHW) system and replacement with new variable refrigerant flow (VRF/VRV) AC system with heat pumps and high efficiency electric panel radiators to circulation areas; associated internal alterations. Amendments sought to include: External alterations to comprise (1) To Main Building Elevations: Relocation of the external condenser units from the south elevation to within the building's existing bin store, removing all externally visible plant; External AC pipework from bin store to be routed from the bin store to main building via a conduit bridge, pipework running on main building elevation to be concealed within metal trunking/boxings colour matched to the elevation; (2) To External Bin Store: installation of a small lead sheet (or equivalent) dormer to the pitched roofslope and replacement of the existing painted timber solid double doorsets with factory finished metal acoustic louvred doors of the same dimension; (3) To External Areas: Installation of 2-3 lightweight timber freestanding bin cupboards within the front garden (to be located adjacent to the south boundary/party wall); Internal alterations to comprise: (1) To External Bin Store: Modification to form a plant room.
